title: Customer's Success Story | Blessed Family Gifts & Customily
summary: Learn how Steven Martinez grew Blessed Family Gifts from message card necklaces to personalized canvases using Customily’s automated fulfillment.
body_markdown:
When **Steven Martinez** talks about gifts, he doesn’t talk about products. He talks about the moment someone opens a present and realizes it was made just for them. That idea is behind[Blessed Family Gifts](https://blessedfamilygifts.com/) , the Shopify store he runs, and it’s what Customily helped him scale.


Steven is a media buyer who took a message-card necklace store into a growing catalog of personalized canvases, ornaments, blankets, and other custom gifts, without hiring a fulfillment team. Along the way, he turned a crowded niche into a personalized gifting brand. Blessed Family Gifts is a family-owned business focused on meaningful artwork inspired by family, faith, and love, and its customers are people shopping for a spouse, a parent, a grandparent, or anyone they want to say “you matter to me” to.


Here’s how he did it with[Customily](https://www.customily.com/) .


## From message card necklaces to personalized gifts


Steven started with message card necklaces, jewelry with a heartfelt message. It worked, until it didn’t stand out anymore. As more stores jumped in with similar products, he knew he needed a different way to compete.


*“The message card necklace market had become extremely competitive, with many stores selling similar products. I knew I needed to find a way to differentiate my business rather than compete solely on price.”*


**Personalization was the answer.** Adding a name, a date, or a meaningful detail makes each gift feel unique, and it raises the perceived value of the product. That let Steven sell at higher price points while giving customers something more personal than anything on a generic shelf.


There was one obstacle: he didn’t have the staff or infrastructure to handle the manual work that custom orders involve. As someone who lives in marketing and media buying, he needed a way to scale without hiring a team just to process designs.


The solution showed up at **The Ecom Family Academy** , an e-commerce training community where Cecilia hosted a live session demonstrating **Customily** and the kinds of personalized products merchants could create.


*“I was impressed by the possibilities, especially the ability to automate personalization and fulfillment. I immediately saw how I could use it to expand my product catalog and stand out in a competitive market.”*


Steven is honest that there was a learning curve at the start. Setting up[personalized products](https://www.customily.com/our-features) , configuring design templates, and understanding the integrations took some time, and[Customily’s training videos](https://www.youtube.com/@CustomilyProductPersonalizer) and resources helped him get there.


Once everything was configured, **things got efficient fast.** Instead of manually processing orders, he could spend his time on what he does best: creating products, testing ads, and generating sales.


## Automation that scales with the busy seasons


For Steven, the most important capability is[automated fulfillment with print-on-demand suppliers](https://www.customily.com/print-on-demand) . Once a product is configured and connected to a supplier, personalized orders go straight to production without anyone touching each one. That reliability matters most in the biggest gifting seasons. During Mother’s Day and Christmas, the store processes a significant number of orders, and having automation in place keeps that volume manageable without building a large team.


His other favorite is the **live personalization preview** . Customers see exactly how their names or custom details will look on the finished product before they buy, which builds confidence at the moment it counts.


Steven’s experience with **Customily** has been very positive, and when he has needed a hand, the team has been there:


*“Whenever I’ve encountered a technical issue or needed help configuring a product, the support team has been helpful and responsive.”*


Steven also values that the platform **keeps growing** , with new features and new supplier integrations that open up more product opportunities for merchants.


## A catalog competitors can’t easily copy


**Blessed Family Gifts** generates **seven figures in annual revenue** and processes **thousands of orders a year,** and personalized products have become an important part of that, especially around Mother’s Day and Christmas. The biggest operational benefit, in Steven’s words, is handling high order volumes without a large team dedicated to manually creating and processing designs. That frees him to focus on what drives growth: product development, advertising, and conversion optimization.


What changed most was the kind of products he could create. Instead of selling the same generic items as hundreds of other stores, **he now develops designs with personalized elements that are much harder to replicate** .


It has also given him more freedom to develop his own product ideas, instead of relying on products that are already popular across the industry. As a media buyer, he also gained more creative angles for his ads and the freedom to test products across different gifting occasions and audiences.


Some of the store’s top performers are[personalized canvases](https://www.customily.com/sell-personalized-products/wall-art-canvas) built around family, love, and meaningful relationships, from street sign canvases with children’s names to “You Are the World” canvases for Mom. The reason they work is emotional.


*“Customers aren’t simply buying wall art; they’re purchasing something that represents their family, their memories, or someone they love.”*


That emotional connection is also what Steven’s customers are looking for. They’re shopping for anniversaries, birthdays, Mother’s Day, Christmas, or simply to show someone how much they care, and **personalization lets them create something specifically for the person receiving it.**


Instead of buying an ordinary gift, they feel like they’re making something meaningful that their loved ones will treasure. **That increases the perceived value and helps justify a higher price compared with generic options.** From a marketing perspective, it’s a built-in selling angle too: showing a customer how a product can be customized just for them helps it stand out.


AI design tools have pushed the possibilities even further. Steven can now create original artwork and combine it with **Customily’s personalization** , for example artwork that weaves in family names or meaningful dates, turning a simple design into a one-of-a-kind gift. It’s a way to take a creative idea and make it something that can be sold and fulfilled at scale.


## Steven’s advice for merchants


If you’re already selling print-on-demand, **test personalization.** You don’t need to start from scratch.


*“You don’t necessarily have to reinvent your entire business. Start by looking at products that have already performed well and think about how personalization could make them more appealing.”*


With **AI design tools** and platforms like[Customily](https://www.customily.com/) , there are more opportunities than ever to create unique products. If you have a winning gift design, try adding family names, important dates, or other meaningful details. And from a media buyer’s perspective, the payoff goes beyond the product itself:


*“Having a strong product angle can make a huge difference. Personalization gives you another way to stand out in your advertising.”*


## What’s next


Steven is always looking for new product opportunities and ways to expand the catalog, and he appreciates that **Customily** keeps adding new supplier partners and product options. He plans to keep testing new personalized products, explore different gifting niches, and use AI to develop creative designs. His goal is to keep building products that combine emotional appeal, personalization, and a great customer experience, while still scaling efficiently.


His story started with a simple problem: a crowded market and no way to stand out. **Personalization gave him a way out, and automation let him grow without growing his workload.** If you already have designs that sell, you may be one personalization away from a product nobody else has.[Start your free trial of Customily](https://app.customily.com/stamp/blogblessedfamily) and see how names, dates, and photos can turn your best sellers into gifts people remember.
